0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 12th in the East, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (5-3, 8th in the West, on a five-game winning streak, 3-1 at home) for the Magic's 9th game of the season. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Golden State is missing Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 120-97 Warriors win in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
